risks.title: Local data loss on disk failure
risks.description: Local-first persistence means operator disk failure can lose agent memory without external backup.
risks.scenario: Operator’s disk fails or volume is wiped. Emotional state, conversations, and dossiers on that volume are gone. Affects any Lite/Expansion user relying solely on one machine.
risks.cause: Single-machine storage model without mandatory off-box backup.
risks.consequence: Loss of conversation and long-term memory; relationship state reset.
risks.mitigation: Document local data ownership; recommend operator backups; atomic writes reduce corruption not disaster loss.

detect: Health checks for state path readability

risks.residual_rationale: Accepted residual: local-first implies operator-owned DR.

risks.title: Memory corruption or inconsistent agent state
risks.description: Persistent state files may become inconsistent after abrupt process kill.
risks.scenario: Power loss mid-write leaves truncated JSON; agent identity or continuity load fails or partially loads.
risks.consequence: Agent identity or memory anomalies; possible fallback to defaults.
risks.mitigation: Atomic temp-file replace patterns in continuity engines; installer repair helpers.

recover: Restore last good backup if available

risks.residual_rationale: Atomic replace reduces likelihood; residual remains for FS failures.

risks.title: GPU detection / VRAM tier mis-selection
risks.description: Incorrect GPU detection can install an inappropriate model tier or fail chat.
risks.scenario: WSL/GPU visibility wrong → Default Model picks wrong tier → poor latency or OOM.
risks.mitigation: Fix-Otacon-GPU.bat; OTACON_LLM_MODEL override; documented VRAM tiers.
risks.residual_rationale: Helpers exist; exotic GPU topologies still fail sometimes.

risks.title: Accidental secret publication
risks.description: Public docs or Engineering evidence could leak private IPs, tokens, or logs.
risks.scenario: Internal executor config copied into public Engineering JSON.
risks.cause: Copying internal executor config into public site
risks.mitigation: Sanitization policy; validator; no private infra in JSON.
risks.residual_rationale: Severity stays high if leak occurs; likelihood reduced by automation.

risks.title: Windows WSL install path incomplete automated proof
risks.description: Automated Windows lab historically lacked nested virt; end-to-end release gate not fully proven.
risks.scenario: Installer regression ships because lab cannot green the full WSL reboot/resume path.
cause_chain: Hang at Windows boot after WSL enable
risks.consequence: Install regressions may escape automated gates
risks.mitigation: Public honesty notes; nested virt lab correction planned; manual verification path.

prevent: Enable nested virt in lab template

roadmap.step: Attach EVID pack + mark ST-003 executed

risks.residual_rationale: Open until a green end-to-end gate exists; residual remains high.

risks.title: Behavioral model drift between releases
risks.description: Personality coefficients or blend rules may change without versioned behavior baseline.
risks.scenario: Silent coefficient edit changes jealousy responses across Expansion agents.
risks.mitigation: Publish MOD/PAR/BVT IDs; track BM version; behavioral regression scenarios.

prevent: BL-BEH baseline + BM version in releases

risks.residual_rationale: Versioning reduces silent drift; BVTs still Verification Pending publicly.

risks.title: Expansion optional sidecars mistaken for READY
risks.description: Users may expect Genome/Video Studio READY on every fresh PC.
risks.scenario: Fresh PC Expansion install; user expects Video Studio READY without Docker/GPU.
risks.consequence: Support burden and perceived product failure
risks.mitigation: Expansion page honesty: optional GPU/Docker; Aria+Deck/Codec installable today.

prevent: Capability status table on Expansion + explainers

risks.residual_rationale: Honesty reduces severity of expectation mismatch.
